This immediately establishes zero-freeness and the sharp additive sup-norm perturbation radius. Endpoint r=0 and all 0≤r<1 are covered. Independent exact symbolic factor identity plus 3000 complex samples were checked; the analytic inequality, not samples, proves the result.
